name: The present–future tense
definition: A verb that begins with one of the letters أ ن ي ت and shows an act now or to come. Its ending changes with the sentence.
body: يَنْصُرُ (he helps), تَنْصُرُ (you help; she helps), أَنْصُرُ (I help), نَنْصُرُ (we help). Al-Ājurrūmiyya gathers its four letters in the word أَنَيْتُ.
It is the one verb with iʿrāb: marfūʿ when nothing governs it (يَنْصُرُ), manṣūb after لَنْ (لَنْ يَنْصُرَ) and majzūm after لَمْ (لَمْ يَنْصُرْ).

examples.text: lam yanṣur, he did not help: majzūm after lam.
